why: The one list of private tool names a refused peer request is counted under. The backend counts only these names, under these kinds, and its table's CHECK names the same ones; lib/peer-refusal-counter.mjs sends only these names. Byte for byte the BGOS file whose content hash is sha256.
howToUpdate: Change the BGOS file first (and its migration CHECK in a new dated migration), then copy it here byte for byte (cp, then cmp) and set sha256 (shasum -a 256). test/peer-private-tools.vendor.test.ts fails on a drift; HOAI_PEER_TOOLS_SOURCE=<BGOS file> compares the bytes too.
